disposition_reason: Element concentrations (mg/L) released from seven Ivorian geophagic clays into simulated gastric and intestinal fluids are printed in Table 5; total clay contents are not reported.

study.design: in vitro gastrointestinal bioaccessibility of geophagic clays
study.origin: Anyama outcrop and Bingerville deposit, Abidjan district, Côte d'Ivoire
study.market: not purchased; collected at outcrop/deposit and prepared like the marketed clay
study.method: Two-step in vitro digestion (modified Cave et al. 2003: pepsin gastric phase pH 2.5, 1 h; bile salts/pancreatin intestinal phase pH 7, 2 h); extracts by ICP-MS (PerkinElmer Elan 5000)

material.label_as_printed: Geophagic clay, in vitro digestion extract (gastric phase, pH 2.5)

findings.notes: Bioaccessible concentration in simulated digestive fluid (1 g clay per 100 mL, 37 °C), ICP-MS; per-litre value kept unconverted, not a concentration in the clay.
